text: The Patriots are suiting up in throwback uniforms for Week 5's home matchup against the 3-1 Raiders, a team riding the surprising excellence of Kirk Cousins' torrid start to the season, while New England's injury situation shows signs of improvement mixed with continued concern—Rhamondre Stevenson has returned to practice after dealing with an injury, but Christian Gonzalez and Carlton Davis remain sidelined, leaving questions about the running back position heading into the contest. In roster moves aimed at fortifying the depth chart, the team signed safety Mike Brown to the 53-man roster from the practice squad and linebacker Jose Ramirez to the practice squad, while the organization also unveiled a new 15,000-square-foot JetBlue Loft at Gillette Stadium as a premium hospitality space that will serve as the home of the Patriots Tailgate Party presented by Bud Light. The 2-2 Patriots are looking to build momentum at home against Las Vegas, though they'll have to contend with a Raiders team that has gotten out to a fast start behind Cousins' exceptional early-season performance.
